summary: This bill amends the Public Health Service Act to require states to include in their plans for substance use prevention, treatment, and recovery block grants detailed information on medication-assisted treatment, including available drugs, diversion prevention protocols, misuse data, and drug screening protocols.

scores.thoughts: The bill amends the Public Health Service Act to require additional information in State plans for substance use prevention, treatment, and recovery services block grants. This directly relates to the provision of healthcare services, specifically for substance use disorders, by requiring more detailed reporting on treatment methods and data.

The bill focuses on improving the reporting and oversight of block grants for substance use prevention, treatment, and recovery services. These services are part of the social safety net, aiming to support individuals struggling with substance abuse. By requiring more detailed plans, it aims to make these services more effective, thus strengthening a component of the social safety net.

This bill directly addresses drug policy by focusing on substance use prevention, treatment, and recovery services. It specifically requires states to provide detailed information on medication-assisted treatment, including types of drugs available, misuse prevention protocols, and drug screening. This aims to improve the effectiveness and oversight of drug treatment policies.
